gcashConfig.instructions:
1. Open GCash app and tap "QR" or "Send Money".
2. Scan this QR Code or send directly to 0917-888-2288.
3. Input the exact Amount Due and Payment Reference Number.
4. Take a screenshot or save the GCash transaction receipt.
5. Upload the proof of payment file below and enter your 13-digit GCash Reference Number.

bankConfig.instructions:
1. Open your banking app.
2. Transfer to the cooperative bank account.
3. Input the exact Amount Due.
4. Take a screenshot or save the transaction receipt.
5. Upload the proof of payment file below.

smsTemplates.name: Loan Payment Overdue Alert

smsTemplates.name: Monthly Regular Savings Deposit Reminder
smsTemplates.content: Dear {{Member Name}} (Member #{{Member Number}}), your monthly regular savings deposit of ₱{{Amount Due}} is due on {{Due Date}}. Keep building your equity with CCT Cooperative!

smsTemplates.name: Share Capital Contribution Call
smsTemplates.content: Dear {{Member Name}}, your scheduled share capital subscription payment of ₱{{Amount Due}} is due on {{Due Date}}. Strengthening your capital increases your annual dividend share.

smsTemplates.name: Time Deposit Maturity Notice

smsTemplates.name: General Member Broadcast Announcement
